Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_EnableMod_too: Turn on the main features of the IKappaID Suite Tools mod.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimHouseSel: ON = players claim safehouses themselves from IKST. OFF = use house request (if enabled) or staff.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimHouseReq: ON = players walk-draw any land zone and staff approve under Claim requests (open ground or buildings). Works with house self-claim OFF.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimSelfBloc: ON = player self-claims cannot cover street tiles. Does not block staff claim requests (admins decide).
Self-claim: keep clear of other safehouses
ON = player self-claims must stay outside a buffer around existing safehouses so paths stay open.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimSelfNear: Buffer tiles around other safehouses when Block near safehouses is ON. 0 = only reject overlapping squares.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimSelfMinT: Minimum area for a player self-claim rectangle.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimSelfMaxT: Maximum area for a player self-claim rectangle.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimSelfRequ: ON = W and H may differ by at most 2 tiles on player self-claims.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimVehicleS: ON = players claim nearby vehicles themselves. OFF = use vehicle request (if enabled) or staff.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimVehicleR: ON = players send unclaimed nearby vehicles to staff under Claim requests. Works with vehicle self-claim OFF.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_MaxVehicleCla: How many vehicles one player may own. 0 = no limit.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_MaxSafehouseC: How many safehouses one player may own. 0 = no limit.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimDuration: Real-life calendar days until a claim expires from the claim date. 0 = no fixed end date. Independent of in-game time speed.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimInactivi: Release the claim if the owner does not use it for this many real-life calendar days. Default 14. 0 = off. If both this and Claim lasts are set, whichever ends first wins.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimVehicleR: Must sit in car to claim
Players must be sitting in the vehicle to claim it (staff can still claim from the list).
Players must start the engine before claiming a vehicle.
Players need the vehicle key (or keys in ignition) to claim it.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimListMaxS: How many claims to show when listing or searching. Higher values can slow menus.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimAdminByp: Allow staff members to access and use any claimed vehicle or safehouse.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimWhitelis: If enabled, only the owner and players specifically added to the whitelist can access the claim. Everyone else is blocked.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimAllowNam: Allow owners to add specific friends or players to their claim's whitelist with custom permissions.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimMaxNamed: Maximum number of players an owner can add to a single claim's whitelist.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimOwnersGr: Allow owners to give whitelisted players more permissions than the default guest settings allow.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimOwnersEd: Allow owners to manage access for groups like Everyone, Faction members, or Safehouse mates.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimVehicleG: Allow any player to get inside a claimed vehicle.
Allow any player to drive a claimed vehicle.
Allow any player to take items from a claimed vehicle's storage.
Allow any player to open or close doors and windows on a claimed vehicle.
Allow any player to add fuel to a claimed vehicle.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimVehicleM: Allow safehouse mates to get inside the owner's claimed vehicles.
Allow safehouse mates to drive the owner's claimed vehicles.
Allow safehouse mates to take items from the owner's claimed vehicles.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ClaimSafehous: Allow any player to build or place items inside a claimed safehouse.
Allow any player to break or dismantle things inside a claimed safehouse.
Allow any player to take items from containers inside a claimed safehouse.
Allow any player to open or close doors in a claimed safehouse.
Allow safehouse members to build or place items inside.
Allow safehouse members to break or dismantle things inside.
Allow safehouse members to take items from containers inside.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_StaffToolsEna: Allow admins to use special tools like healing, giving items, or editing the world.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_EnableThreatT: Allow admins to use tools for managing zombies and checking player threats.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_EnableCatchJa: Allow admins to use the catch and jail features to manage players.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_EnableUtiliti: Allow staff to turn water and power on or off for the whole server.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_StaffRemoteAd: DANGER: When enabled, protect-radius and similar tools work map-wide from any distance. Not recommended for public servers.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_CatchMaxDista: Maximum distance (tiles) for Catch when StaffRemoteAdmin is off.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_StaffRespectS: In multiplayer, staff world tools only work inside safe areas where they have permission. Solo mode ignores this.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_RateLimitEnab: Prevent players from spamming commands to help keep the server running smoothly.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_StrictRemoteR: In multiplayer, apply tighter rate limits to remote admin clients (loot, tiles, vehicles). Host and solo keep normal limits.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_AuditLogEnabl: Record important actions to the server log for security and troubleshooting.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_AuditLogMaxEn: How many recent audit log entries to keep in memory.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_DebugLogEnabl: Print [IKST-DEBUG] lines to the client and server console for command and sync troubleshooting. Turn on for IB playtests; leave off on public servers.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_DebugLogVerbo: Reserved for extra debug detail in a future update.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_DebugLogMaxEn: How many recent [IKST-DEBUG] lines to keep for the Debug tail tool.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_RecoveryJourn: Allow the use of skill books that let players save and recover their skills after death.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_LockMaxAttemp: How many wrong password guesses are allowed before a keypad lock freezes for 60 seconds.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_LockInstallDi: How close a player must be to a door to install a keypad lock.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_VehicleNearRa: How close a player must be to a vehicle to claim it.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_VehicleListRa: How far to look for vehicles when using the old search tool. Use the Vehicles addon for better results.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_BriefingEnabl: Show the Server Briefing in the ESC menu and IKST Everyone workspace.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_BriefingMaxSe: Maximum characters per briefing section (defaults plus host overrides).
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ArrivalStabil: Short zombie-immunity grace after join or respawn while the player syncs in.
How long arrival stabilization lasts. Set to 0 to disable the timer.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ArrivalOnJoin: Apply arrival stabilization when a player connects to the server.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ArrivalOnResp: Apply arrival stabilization after death when the character respawns.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ArrivalAttack: End arrival stabilization immediately if the player starts an attack.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ArrivalMoveEn: End arrival stabilization if the player moves beyond the threshold distance.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_ArrivalMoveTh: How far a player can move before arrival grace ends when moving ends grace is enabled.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_UnstuckEnable: Allow players to use Unstuck from the Everyone workspace (server finds a free nearby tile).
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_UnstuckCooldo: Minimum wait between Unstuck uses per player.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_EventTpEnable: Allow staff to set an event point and players to Join / Return from Everyone.
Sandbox_IKappaIDSuiteTools_EventTpCooldo: Minimum wait between event Join or Return uses per player (limits teleport shuttling).
